item.title: Next phase of apartments at large Saukville project advancing
item.description: Seeing strong demand for housing in Ozaukee County, Milwaukee-based Three Leaf Partners is moving ahead with a second phase of apartments at a nearly 100-acre mixed-use development in Saukville. item.title: Illinois-based packaging manufacturer plans to add operations in Oak Creek
item.description: A nationwide packaging and display manufacturer plans to occupy space in an industrial building in Oak Creek’s OakView Corporate Park. item.title: Uihlein family member files lawsuit over records tied to Port Washington data center
item.description: Lynde Uihlein has filed a lawsuit against the city, alleging officials failed to respond to an open records request related to Vantage's data center.

item.title: Former Best Western in West Milwaukee sells for $10.4 million
item.description: A West Milwaukee building that previously housed a hotel has been purchased for $10.4 million, according to state property records. An affiliate of Milwaukee-based Bayside Development acquired the property at 5501 W. National Ave., which was previously a Best Western Plus hotel. item.title: See photos from Visit Milwaukee’s annual meeting
item.description: Visit Milwaukee recently held its annual meeting at the Bradley Symphony Center in downtown Milwaukee, drawing more than 800 business and community leaders. The destination marketing organization had record-breaking sales in 2025, booking 328,659 room nights and reaching 114% of its goal, a 14.4% year-over-year increase. item.description: A 10,960-square-foot home on the west end of Geneva Lake in Fontana’s north shore area was sold recently for $14.3 million, according to state records. item.description: The U.S. Post Office building at 606 E. Juneau Ave. in Milwaukee’s Yankee Hill neighborhood, near downtown, has been sold for $8.5 million, according to state records.
